{{Top|leg}}
A '''Bayonard Blaster Carry Permit''' was a type of permit that allowed the bearer to carry a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] in [[Bayonard]], a [[platform city]] that was located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Cularin/Legends|Cularin]]. They were valid indefinitely.

{{Stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The permit made its only appearance in ''[[Trade Wars: Find the Lady|Find the Lady]]'', an adventure in the [[Living Force (roleplaying campaign)|Living Force]] campaign. In the adventure, the [[Heroes of Cularin|player characters]] visit Bayonard and on arrival there, any players who declare that they have a blaster are given a blaster carry permit.
